faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.subtitle: The things clients ask before we start. If yours isn't here, just ask.

items.q: How do you price a project, and what does it cost?
items.a: Most engagements start around $10k for a focused build and scale with complexity; larger platforms run $50k–$100k+. We price per fixed scope or as a monthly dedicated team after a short discovery call — you'll always see a clear estimate before any commitment.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Most mobile apps ship in 3–6 months; web platforms in 2–5 months; large corporate or hardware+AI systems in 6–18 months. We commit to a roadmap with milestones up front and demo progress weekly.

items.q: Who owns the code and the IP?
items.a: You do — 100%. Full source code and IP rights transfer to you on final delivery and payment. No lock-in, no hidden licensing.
Every release ships with a documented QA process and a post-launch support window to fix any defects we find together. After that, you can continue with a flexible Maintenance & Support retainer.

items.q: How do you communicate during the project?
items.a: A dedicated channel, a single point of contact, weekly demos of working software, and shared access to the roadmap and progress board. You're never guessing where your project stands.

items.q: Where is your team based, and how do timezones work?
items.a: We're headquartered in Toronto, Canada, with a strong delivery team across Egypt and the MENA region — overlapping working hours with North America and Europe.

items.q: Do you sign NDAs and keep projects confidential?
items.a: Yes. We sign an NDA before any detailed discussion, and we can keep client names, brands, and details fully private — several of our builds are confidential by request.

items.q: Can you work with our existing team or codebase?
items.a: Absolutely. We can join as a dedicated squad building alongside you, augment your team with specific engineers, or take ownership of an existing codebase after a technical audit.
